Timeline.node_product_content: End-to-end Product Lifecycle, lean methodologies, and supply chain scaling (KQ Universitários / Avolta Group).
Timeline.node_engineering_content: Civil Engineering rigor meets Industrial Automation execution. Building robust, predictable systems.
Timeline.node_design_content: Systemic Thinking, Service Design, Technical Design Leadership, and Design for Scalability.
Timeline.node_code_content: AI Implementation: Agent-based workflows. System Architecture: Data schemas for inventory. Technical Proficiency: End-to-end DNS/Cloud. Automation-First Approach: API-led integrations.
Timeline.node_founder_content: Founded and scaled KQ Personalizados nationally for ~10 years. Built a system that ran autonomously for 12 months and was sold as an operational asset. Full P&L, Supply Chain and stakeholder management.
Timeline.node_pm_content: Project Delivery & Operations: Leading complex launches, Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban), and operational excellence in multinational environments.

Timeline_Dossier.title: Curriculum Vitae
Timeline_Dossier.item1_desc: Opened the group's 1st restaurant in Latin America (US$15.8B global revenue). Acted as Supply Chain Buyer, bridge between international stakeholders and local operations, and Product Owner of the 'Digital' software — integrating Brazil's fiscal complexity into Avolta's global Oracle Inventory Management system.
Timeline_Dossier.item2_desc: Founded and scaled a national custom manufacturing operation (+12 product lines). Built a system that ran autonomously for 12 months during the Ireland transition. Sold as a fully operational asset — proof of systemic antifragility.
Timeline_Dossier.item3_desc: Developed Python RPA automations for UFJF's Infrastructure Department. The project was expanded by other students to multiple departments after the internship ended — direct validation of the initial architecture's robustness.
Timeline_Dossier.item4_desc: Civil Engineering degree pursued in parallel with founding and growing KQ. Structural logic, systems thinking and engineering rigor applied to business management from day one.
Timeline_Dossier.item5_desc: Process standardization, production documentation and quality control in a high-throughput industrial environment. Practical foundation for managing complex operations.
Timeline_Dossier.item6_desc: Technical training in Industrial Automation. Focus on control logic, redundant systems, and process architecture that eliminates the need for constant supervision.
